CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files(path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, stamp TEXT, lines_indexed INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE files ADD COLUMN lines_indexed INTEGER
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviewed(session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT, ts TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions(session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, project TEXT, cwd TEXT, title TEXT,first_ts TEXT, last_ts TEXT, messages INTEGER,engine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude')
ALTER TABLE sessions ADD COLUMN engine TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_projects(project_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, origin TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS msg USING fts5(session_id UNINDEXED, project UNINDEXED, ts UNINDEXED, role UNINDEXED,content, tokenize='porter unicode61')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS beliefs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, subject TEXT NOT NULL, claim TEXT NOT NULL,confidence REAL NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',superseded_by INTEGER, resolution TEXT, created TEXT, updated TEXT,last_referenced TEXT)
ALTER TABLE beliefs ADD COLUMN last_referenced TEXT
UPDATE beliefs SET last_referenced = updated WHERE last_referenced IS NULL
ALTER TABLE beliefs ADD COLUMN writer TEXT
ALTER TABLE beliefs ADD COLUMN via TEXT
ALTER TABLE beliefs ADD COLUMN source_engine TEXT
ALTER TABLE beliefs ADD COLUMN uid TEXT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS beliefs_uid ON beliefs(uid)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS belief_evidence(belief_id INTEGER, session_id TEXT, project TEXT, note TEXT, created TEXT, source_engine TEXT)
ALTER TABLE belief_evidence ADD COLUMN source_engine TEXT
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS belief_fts USING fts5(belief_id UNINDEXED, claim, tokenize='porter unicode61')
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dream_reviewed(a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(a, b))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS belief_edges(src INTEGER NOT NULL, dst INTEGER NOT NULL, rel TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, note TEXT, created TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(src, dst, rel))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS belief_edges_dst ON belief_edges(dst, rel)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS belief_edge_assertions(src INTEGER NOT NULL, dst INTEGER NOT NULL, rel TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(src, dst, rel, session_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS belief_outcomes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, belief_id INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event IN ('confirmed','contradicted','stale')), source TEXT NOT NULL, session_id TEXT, agent TEXT, note TEXT, created TEXT)
ALTER TABLE belief_outcomes ADD COLUMN uid TEXT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS belief_outcomes_uid ON belief_outcomes(uid)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_ops(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, op_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, machine_id TEXT NOT NULL, machine_seq INTEGER NOT NULL, lamport INTEGER NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL, op TEXT NOT NULL, project_key TEXT, payload TEXT NOT NULL, mac TEXT, created TEXT NOT NULL, applied INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sync_ops_order ON sync_ops(lamport, machine_id, machine_seq)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sync_ops_slot ON sync_ops(machine_id, machine_seq) WHERE applied != 2
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_machine(machine_id TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT, lamport INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_peers(peer TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pushed_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pulled_cursor TEXT, last_push TEXT, last_pull TEXT, last_error TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_belief_aliases(uid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, belief_id INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_conflicts(kind TEXT NOT NULL, bucket TEXT NOT NULL, old_key TEXT NOT NULL, a_text TEXT NOT NULL, b_text TEXT NOT NULL, op_id TEXT NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind, bucket, old_key, op_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_remote_records(class TEXT NOT NULL, project_key TEXT, machine_id TEXT NOT NULL, record TEXT NOT NULL, updated TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(class, project_key, machine_id))
